vulns.title: Staking-time inflation via receipt merge
vulns.root_cause: merge_receipts sums the hours_staked of its two input receipts (hours1 + hours2). Because credited staking time is duplicated on every merge, an attacker can accumulate MIN_STAKE_HOURS of staking time far faster than real elapsed time — stake into several receipts, let a little time pass, update them, and merge — then call claim_rewards to withdraw the principal plus the loyalty reward long before having genuinely staked that long, draining rewards from the pool.
